description: Chat scenarios. 'check' cases are scored by code; 'metrics' cases are scored by the judge (JUDGE_MODEL, a decision model) with narrow yes/no checks: a check is [question, expected answer], and every check must hold. 'check' metrics inside 'metrics' are verified by code.

cases.prompt: A train travels at 60 km/h for 2.5 hours and then at 80 km/h for 1.5 hours. What is the total distance in km? Answer with only the number.
What is the next number in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30? Answer with only the number.
Return ONLY a valid JSON object with the keys "name" (string) and "age" (integer) for this sentence: Maria is 34 years old. No explanation, no code fences.
Write exactly 3 bullet points about the benefits of regular exercise. Start every line with "- ". Output nothing else.
Responda em português, em uma única frase: qual é a capital do Brasil?
What is the invoice number shown in the image? Answer with only the number.
Who wrote the novel "Dom Casmurro" and in what year was it published?
cases.expected: Machado de Assis wrote it, and it was published in 1899.

metrics.name: Correctness
checks: Does the answer name Machado de Assis as the author?
Does the answer say that it was published in 1899?
Does the answer give a year other than 1899, or an author other than Machado de Assis?

cases.prompt: Em que ano o Brasil declarou a independência de Portugal e quem a proclamou? Responda em português.
cases.expected: Em 1822, proclamada por Dom Pedro I.

metrics.name: Correctness
checks: Does the answer say that the independence was in 1822?
Does the answer name Dom Pedro (Pedro I) as the one who proclaimed it?
Does the answer give a year other than 1822, or someone other than Dom Pedro as the one who proclaimed it?

cases.prompt: Explain in two sentences what a vector database is used for.

metrics.name: Relevancy and content
checks: Does the answer say that a vector database stores vectors or embeddings?
Does the answer say that it is used to search by similarity or meaning?
Is the answer about a different subject, or does it only ask for more information instead of answering?

cases.question: Can I get a refund for a monthly plan 10 days after buying it?
cases.context: Acme Cloud refund policy: annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are never refunded. Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
cases.expected: No. Monthly plans are never refunded.

metrics.name: Correctness
checks: Does the answer say that a refund is not possible?
Does the answer say that a refund is possible, or offer an alternative such as credit?

cases.question: I am ordering $40 of items to Canada. How much is express shipping and when would it arrive?
cases.context: Acme Store shipping: orders over $50 ship free within the US. Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping costs $15 and takes 1 to 2 business days. International shipping is not available.
cases.expected: Express shipping to Canada is not available, because international shipping is not available.

metrics.name: Correctness
checks: Does the answer say that shipping to Canada (international shipping) is not available?
Does the answer give a price or a delivery time for shipping to Canada?

cases.question: Does Acme Cloud offer a student discount?
cases.context: Acme Cloud refund policy: annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are never refunded. Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
cases.expected: The context does not say whether a student discount exists.

cases.question: How many seats does the Acme Cloud Pro plan include?
cases.context: Acme Cloud refund policy: annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are never refunded. Approved refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
cases.expected: The context does not say how many seats the Pro plan includes.

cases.prompt:
Summarize the following text in ONE sentence.

Text: The city council voted on Tuesday to build a new 4 km bike lane along River Avenue. Construction will start in March and cost 2.3 million dollars, funded mostly by a state transport grant. Local shop owners worried about losing parking spaces, so the council promised 40 new spaces in a nearby lot. The lane is expected to open before summer next year.
